integrity: All finite counts derive from an exhaustive standalone exact GF(4) computation and a separately described projective-frame argument.
scientific_limitations: Counts concern rational pencils whose five rational conics are geometrically smooth over F4 and rational projective lines; no general-field extension or independent validation is claimed.
title: The 108 optimal skew-line triples of every smooth conic pencil over \(\mathbf F_4\)
